title: Pinwheel Bouquets That Did Not Bend
youtube_title: Pinwheel Bouquets That Did Not Bend | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A second try works better when nobody is blamed and everybody has a job.
summary: Tilde, Otto, and Mama pack paper pinwheels into smaller bouquets with paper collars, trade jobs when the hurry rises, and deliver them unbent.
